description: Discover project roots, support status, and matching adapters without auditing source targets. Use this when project boundaries are needed before a specialized workflow; use analyze_repository for a complete review. Reads local repository markers and returns project-detection/v1 without executing tests or writing files.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional exact project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before returning detected projects.

repoRoot.description: Readable repository directory whose project markers should be inspected.

name: detect_projects

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/project-detection-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Detect Projects
